card.name: Words just before "increase" in dosing
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs such as consider, or, before, be, is, and a comma, placed right before the word increase or increasing in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Before increasing a dose
modes.description: A linking word such as before, or, or to comes right ahead of increasing the dose.
modes.example: or after starting<< or>> increasing the dose of pramipex

modes.label: Passive or advisory wording
modes.description: Words like be, is, or consider precede increased or resuming-dose wording.
modes.example: the dose may<< be>> increased to 20 mg/kg per

modes.label: After a condition clause
modes.description: A comma follows a symptom or condition and the next word is increase.
modes.example: If symptoms of adrenal insufficiency occur<<,>> increase total daily dosage.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict increase or increased as the next word, and away from replacement words.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a dose is raised, where the next word is likely to be increase.
